svg.title: Identity — Kartikeya Yadav
svg.desc: A dark, quiet frame. A beam of light falls from the top right and dust drifts through it: every mote is one day I shipped in the last twelve months (182 days, 2,507 contributions), placed left to right by date and as bright as that day was busy. A soft aura breathes behind the statement: I build AI agents that act — and prove it, with a person in charge. Each claim is cited to the work that backs it: [1] Ai Agents: Agentic systems are the core of the work: AEGIS, ForgeSRE, EraseOps and Chakraview, built end to end, model to product, running where the data lives. [2] That Act: They change real systems. ForgeSRE restarts services and rolls back production; EraseOps deletes a customer across PostgreSQL and object storage. [3] And Prove It: 31 of 31 attacks held on AEGIS. 3,639 tests in JKY Terminal. Every Evidence Console answer cites the exact video second or PDF page. [4] A Person In Charge: ForgeSRE stops for a human before a rollback. EraseOps runs only after one exact plan hash is approved, then rescans to zero.
